target_customer: Crypto beginners wanting to learn about and buy Bitcoin through a chat style app
problem: Newcomers found buying and storing crypto confusing; Ben combined a chatbot, lessons, news and a wallet to teach and sell Bitcoin.
business_model: Transaction fee on crypto purchases (reported at 1 percent)
product_category: Consumer crypto app, chatbot wallet and education

founders.name: Miguel Kudry
founders.background_notes: YC page lists him as Founder/CEO with no bio.

founders.name: Alex Sismanis
founders.background_notes: YC bio: software engineer, full stack, cryptocurrency and blockchain developer. Product Hunt lists him as former CTO.

exit.reason: Cause not public; YC lists Ben as Inactive and the ben.co domain did not resolve in this session.

competitors.name: Coinbase
competitors.what: Established crypto exchange and wallet; TechCrunch said Ben avoided competing head to head by targeting beginners
competitors.traction_then: Established market leader (no figure in source)

competitors.name: Circle
competitors.what: Established crypto and payments company named by TechCrunch alongside Coinbase

technical_complexity.rationale: A chatbot interface, bank funding and a custodial or noncustodial wallet with seed phrase backup; moderate engineering plus compliance work, built by two people.

defensibility.rationale: Large exchanges could add education and chat features easily, and Ben had no network effect or proprietary data.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Coinbase and others kept building beginner friendly products; no source shows an acquisition of Ben.

market_need_then: Crypto prices and public interest peaked around December 2017, with many new buyers confused by exchanges; TechCrunch (March 2018) noted a beginner audience.

branding.domain_note: Used the short domain ben.co, not .com; it did not resolve in this session.

identity.mascot_or_character: Chatbot persona called Ben, described as an AI Bitcoin friend

branding.brand_signature: A friendly chatbot named Ben that you text to buy Bitcoin
branding.community_and_virality: Covered by TechCrunch and PYMNTS in 2018, with Product Hunt launches on 2018-03-14, 2018-05-21 and 2018-09-14.

brand_strength.rationale: A friendly human name fit the chatbot concept and earned press and Product Hunt launches, but the name is generic and hard to search, and no lasting community was found.

outcome_analysis: Ben was a two person San Diego crypto beginner app that raised a 580 thousand dollar pre seed in March 2018 and added Ethereum in September 2018. The cause of its becoming inactive is not public, so failure factors are left empty. The 2018 crypto price collapse and strong exchange competition are plausible context but no source ties them to Ben.
notes: CB Insights reports 680K total raised with the latest round a convertible note (Series III) and Y Combinator as investor; this is 100K above the 580K TechCrunch pre seed, and the gap (possibly the YC deal) is not itemised. Y Combinator in the round investors is from the CB Insights entry, not TechCrunch. TechCrunch did not name the founders; names come from the YC page. Founding year not found. Company website did not resolve.
